description: Pass required. Everything Settled knows about one payTo address: the endpoints it is paid for, live/dead counts, price range, clone-farm and quote-only flags, on-chain settlements and unique payers. Use when: several endpoints share a seller and you want to judge the seller rather than one URL, or a payTo looks unfamiliar. Not for: a single endpoint’s status (settled_check). Input is the wallet address from a 402 quote.

address.description: The payTo address from a 402 quote: 0x followed by 40 hex characters (Base)

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

name: settled_seller_reputation

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

claim.description: The seller's claim and profile, if claimed

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

flags.description: Seller flags such as clone_farm or quote_only

settlement_integrity.description: Whether paid activity looks organic or self-generated

title: Seller reputation by payTo address
